definitionZh: 不透明 CSS 属性设置元素的不透明 。 不透明是元素背后的内容隐藏的程度,与透明度相反.
sourceDefinition: The opacity CSS property sets the opacity of an element. Opacity is the degree to which content behind an element is hidden, and is the opposite of transparency.
